world.title: Chu Kingdom
world.introText: The Chu Kingdom, also formally known as the Chu Dynasty or Chu Empire, was a major empire on the Qian Long Continent ruled by the Xiang [Royal] Clan. Founded after the betrayal and assassination of the First Emperor (Ying Zheng), the dynasty reigned for centuries before being completely overthrown by the Qin Clan during the events of the Mortal Realm arc.
world.appearance:
The decline of the Chu Dynasty was heavily accelerated by its final ruler, Emperor Xiang Guang. Unlike his ancestors, Xiang Guang was an incompetent, paranoid, and tyrannical ruler. His poor internal diplomacy and deep-seated fear of the Qin Clan's growing military power led him to make disastrous political decisions that alienated his vassals.

The breaking point of his reign was his decision to send assassins to eliminate Qin De. This covert operation resulted in the death of Qin De's wife, Jing Yi. This act destroyed any remaining diplomatic facade and gave the Qin Clan the ultimate justification to launch their long-planned rebellion. Furthermore, Xiang Guang's political incompetence made it remarkably easy for the Qin covert network (Secret Arrow) to infiltrate and turn the Mu and Shangguan clans against the imperial crown. The open war was the assumed death of Qin Yu during an imperial assassination attempt against his father. Following this event, the Qin Clan launched their rebellion, systematically dismantling the Chu Dynasty's vassal support through extensive covert operations. It was later revealed that the Southern Lords, the Mu Clan, had maintained a secret alliance with the Qin Clan for generations; their sudden defection was the execution of a long-planned conspiracy. Concurrently, Qin intelligence agents assassinated the Northern Lord, Shangguan Hong, and successfully framed Emperor Xiang Guang for the murder. This forced the enraged Shangguan Clan to turn their armies against the crown, leaving the Chu military completely isolated and causing its entire imperial structure to rapidly collapse from within.

During the Qin Rebellion, the Chu Dynasty's military quickly collapsed under the coordinated betrayal of its vassal clans. In a last desperate attempt to save the empire, the founding emperor of Chu, Xiang Yang—who had been cultivating in secret and reached the Yuanying (Nascent Soul) stage—emerged from seclusion.

Despite his immense power, Xiang Yang was ultimately killed in a joint assault by Qin Yu and Hei Yu. With their greatest protector dead and the capital breached by rebel forces, Emperor Xiang Guang committed suicide by poison, marking the official end of the Chu Dynasty and the Xiang bloodline.
world.trivia: External Diplomacy and Geopolitics: In the Donghua (animation), the Chu Kingdom is often depicted as the sole hegemon of the continent before the Qin take over. In the Web Novel, the political landscape is much broader. The Chu Dynasty was only one of three major empires sharing the Qian Long continent, maintaining tense borders and external diplomacy with the Ming Dynasty and the Han Dynasty. world.title: Mortal Realm
world.introText: The Mortal Realm is the world where ordinary humans and low-level cultivators reside. It is a place where the laws of nature are simpler compared to higher realms like the Immortal Realm or the Divine Realm. However, it is still a dangerous and competitive world, with powerful sects, ancient clans, and hidden experts vying for resources, power, and immortality. The Mortal Realm is divided into various kingdoms, continents, and regions, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges.

characters.history:
/ This Qian Long Continent Arc needs rewriting, it's not accurate (I fixed first few parts. If others are contain missing or wrong information please edit and fix it.)/

External Training - Qin Yu, the third Prince of the Qin clan, son of Qin De had always had problem with his dantian ,which prohibits him from practicing in the internal arts that a majority of people practice. Thus his father decided to send him to Misty Villa to live where he befriended his companion Hei Yu, but Qin Yu, longing for his father's approval wanted to train himself in the external practices. After Qin De learns about his wish, he arranged for some external arts practitioners to demonstrate themselves for Qin Yu to choose. Qin Yu decided to choose a person seemed to be respected by other experts even though his power is mediocre than other experts. After training Qin Yu for a year his master returned to army and left Qin Yu to train by himself. Qin Yu then decided to go out of the mountain to a small village not far away, there he met some of his old friends that he befriended 3 years ago. After briefly staying at that village and promising his friends that he'd return with gifts he left. While he was gone the village encountered some bandits. The bandits ended up killing some village residents before Qin Yu returned. When Qin Yu returned and discovered that his friends were seriously injured he became furious, Qin Yu then proceeded to kill all of the bandits using his external practices. He then returned to the Misty Villa to continue his training.

At his coming of age ceremony, Qin Yu is told of the secret plans that his father and brothers are enacting. However given his lack of abilities, he quickly realises that he can't be of any help. Taking his leave and while contemplating this, he sees a meteor shooting towards Misty Villa, but it suddenly disappears. A short while later he discovers that the meteor that has the shape of a tear landed near the hot spring and it merges with his body bestowing unparalleled healing and reinvigoration abilities. Qin Yu uses the effects of the meteoric tear to put his training into overdrive. Qin Yu continues to overcome his limits and on a day sparring with Hei Yu (better known as Xiao Hei) ends up finding what turns out to be In-Rock Forging Iron. Fengyuzi ends up forging Qin Yu a short sword and knuckle protecting gloves from the In-Rock Forging Iron and Qin Yu blood binds them enabling them to be stored within his dantian. Later Qin Yu is able to feel the Xiantian door by becoming one with nature and using the power of the meteoric tear before breaking through by almost drowning himself.

As an assassin of the Heavenly Net under the pseudo name of Liu Xing, Qin Yu killed Zhen Xu and his subordinates Nalan Dan and Nalan Feng causing the reputation of Liu Xing to rise within the Heavenly Net giving him the status of a Top Class Gold Mask assassin. However when he carried out the assignment, he also managed to take the first Trans-Heaven diagram which was intended for Xiang Guang along with some secrets regarding Qin De's plans for rebellion. Utilising his body that is beyond any other expert in the Qian Long continent, he's able to master the diagrams and increase his speed and strength. Later on his way back to the prince mansion, he arrives just in time to witness Lian Yan and Yi Qing Yu kill one another. In his fury at losing his Uncle Lian, he murders the Yi Qing Yu's party. After a period of mourning, he recalls that his holy sense located the second Trans-Heaven diagram at the scene of the fight. He deduces that the diagram would've been hidden away in the secret weapons storage of the prince mansion where he locates not only the second Trans-Heaven diagram but also the third Trans-Heaven diagram which he quickly masters. Qin Yu is then invited by the Heavenly Net on a mission to bodyguard Mister Ying who turns out to be his father Qin De. Qin De is about to undergo his minor heavenly tribulation and suspects that Xiang Guang will attempt to interfere. Xiang Guang sends Wu De and Wu Xing, two cultivators and the Four Directions Death Gods who are peak Xiantian experts. Qin Yu who has undergone the mission as Liu Xing and kept his identity secret from everyone, is happy to share some time with his father, however as his father's heavenly tribulation arrives, the group is attacked. Qin Yu kills the Four Directions Death Gods and Ge Min who turns out be a spy for Xiang Guang and in the process of protecting his father from Wu Xing is stabbed through the heart. He manages to smash Wu Xing heart and Hei Yu comes down to embrace his dying body at which point lighting strikes and when it disappears, Qin Yu, now back in his proper form, Hei Yu and even Wu Xing have disappeared seemingly turned to dust by the lightning strike.

Qin Yu awakes in the Separate Villa, a special villa that has been left by Lei Wei deep within the Wilderness for whomever is able to master the Trans-Heaven diagrams. Scarlet, the artificial intelligence tells him the history of Lei Wei and takes on Qin Yu as its 2nd master before bestowing upon Qin Yu the Menghuan Ring and showing Qin Yu the path to proceed upon to the Stellar Transformations. Though Qin Yu is eager to return to the Qian Long Continent he acknowledges that his current strength is insufficient to make the journey back through the wilderness. While training to build up his strength, Xiao Hei undergoes his 4-in-9 Heavenly Tribulation and is attacked by 1000 Blue Flame Wolves. Qin Yu slaughters 300 wolves by himself and then later undergoes his own 4-in-9 Heavenly Tribulation before setting off on his journey to return to the Qian Long continent. On the journey back, Qin Yu and Xiao Hei end up encountering the Yan fox sisters which puts them on a collision course with the Shen brothers and Qin Yu is forced to use his most formidable attack, the Stellar Field which he is now capable of having reached the Nebula Stage of Stellar Transformation. Both Qin Yu and Xiao Hei defeat the Shen brothers and continued on their journey back to the Qian Long continent before encountering the Dragon Rocky Lion divine beast. After managing to escape with his life, he returns to the Qian Long continent and seeks out his father who has reached a stalemate in his war against the Xiang Dynasty. Hearing that the only way to resolve the war is to kill Xiang Yang, Qin Yu and Xiao Hei issue a challenge to Xiang Yang. In a massive battle, Qin Yu unleashes his new most formidable attack having now reached the middle point of the Nebula Stage and performs the Meteor Strike. Xiang Yang having taken such damage from both of Qin Yu and Xiao Hei's ultimate attacks performs the Yuanying self-destruction technique. Qin Yu is able to escape the effects of the technique by diving into the river. Having been victorious, he practices in the Qian Long continent for a year and after seeing his brother Qin Zheng ascend to the throne and marking the creation of the Qin Dynasty, Qin Yu along with Xiao Hei embark on their journey to the cultivation world.

Qin Yu and Xiao Hei travel the boundless ocean before deciding to explore the underwater cultivation world. However as they reach the depth at whist the cultivators dwell, they find themselves in trouble as the group is attacked by Sang Mo, one of the 13 guardians of the Blood Red Cave and his brothers. After battling for a while, Qin Yu ends up murdering Sang Tu, who is Sang Mo's son before escaping using the Meteor Escaping Art. Qin Yu, who is now separated from Xiao Hei decides that in order to better understand the environment and increase his chances of survival he will need to learn the Xiumo secret technique Soul Examination which was in one of the books that Lei Wei left behind. Upon learning the secret technique, he understands better the world of cultivators in which he now dwells, though the danger that he himself is in, remains at a high level. Sang Mo raised the bounty on Qin Yu which lead to his battle against Cha Ge, a battle that despite being victorious, took him to the precipice between life and death once more. While allowing for the meteoric tear to heal his wounds, he loses consciousness only to awaken and upon some investigation he meets Uncle Lan who informs him that he was brought to the home of Li'er. Qin Yu meets Li'er, and is also introduced to Uncle Lan's disciple Hou Fei, a one of a kind Fiery-Eyed Aquatic Monkey divine beast. While getting his first respite since going underwater, he reaches the late nebula stage before journeying back towards danger, only this time with Hou Fei at his side. Having learned North Darkness a Xiumo secret art that hides his aura and having changed his appearance to Liu Xing, both Qin Yu and Hou Fei become guardians of the Blood Red Cave. Sang Mo who suspects Liu Xing to be the Xiuzhenist Qin Yu, ends up orchestrating that Qin Yu should be part of the hung for Xiao Hei. It is on the hunt for Xiao Hei that Qin Yu murders two of the guardians while Zhuang Zhong kills the other and pledges allegiance to Qin Yu. Qin Yu uses much of his time as a guardian of the Blood Red Cave to improve and after reaching the earlier Meteor Stage, he ends up witnessing the secret fight between Cha Hong, the leader of the Blood Red Cave and Di Tong, a Purple Demon Aquatic Dragon and a King in one of the superpowers of the cultivation world. In the aftermath of the fight, Qin Yu takes the opportunity to kill Di Tong. After the other guardians find out that Cha Hong has perished, a new leader must be selected, having just reached the medium Meteor Stage, Qin Yu defeats Teng Bi and becomes the Blood Red Cave leader.

Having ascended to the height of Red Cave leader the first thing that Qin Yu does is appoint Hou Fei as second master and Xiao Hei as third master, positions equal to that of himself. He then undergoes closed training to solidify his position by increasing his power. A short while Qin Yu, he's forced to battle Qingxuan who he manages to dispatch with a single strike having now reached the late Meteor stage and having reforged his gloves and short sword to make into top grade holy weapons. Having secured the tranquility of the Red Cave and consolidated the power, Qin Yu pays a visit to Jiang Lan in the ravine where he also unexpectedly grows closer to Jiang Li. After he returns to the Red Cave ridge he garners favor with guardians by preventing the death of one of them who is being interrogated by three of the eight remaining Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons of the Nine Demons Hall. Being that the Red Cave is within the territory, the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons Di Qing, Di Luan and Di Jian force to Qin Yu to return with them to the Nine Demons Hall. Upon the way, they go to rest Purple Demon Tower within the Great Shell Cave, where both Lou Ke and Teng Shan attempt to steal him away for  his knowledge of the eight of the Nine Jade Swords. During the commotion, Qin Yu takes the opportunity to secretly kill Di Qing. However Lou Ke and Teng Shan are forced to retreat returning Qin Yu back to the custody of the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons of the Nine Demons Halls. Fearing another ambush, the journey back to the Nine Demons Halls is expedited. Despite Qin Yu's sophistry, he's put into the Universal Palace which is the jail of the Nine Demons Hall before being rescued by the efforts of Teng Shan and Lou Ke who have spies implanted in the prison. Qin Yu is set free and told where to meet Teng Shan and Lou Ke but he decides not to go there before he steals the whole Treasure Storing Palace of the Nine Demons Halls infuriating the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons further. Qin Yu then flees to the Black Rock Island to meet Lou Ke and Teng Shan but only at a speed fast enough to keep the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons on his tail.

Qin Yu is fighting the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons on Black Rock Island and gets trapped in a Six Harmonies Heavenly Gates Formation that the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons create, it's at this point that Hou Fei turns up to rescue him. However before Hou Fei can rescue Qin Yu, two divine beasts, a three-eyed frog and Yan Lang, an Azure Dragon turn up. Three-Eyed ends up freeing Qin Yu from the formation who then showcases a mortal skill called Short Force. Three-Eyed and Yan Lang both team up with the Purple Demon Aquatic Dragons which forces Qin Yu to call Jiang Lan for assistance. To keep Hou Fei alive, he's forced to use both his Stellar Field - Nine Meteors Blazing and his Nine Meteors Unification, Meteor Strike skills to buy time. After Jiang Lan arrives, in recognition of his power, the cultivators present decide to gift Qin Yu two caves each to establish Qin Yu as the sixth superpower of the cultivation world. Jiang Lan names the new superpower Stellar Tower, he also create the Great Heavenly Stellar Formation. Three years later at the official opening of the superpowers of the cultivation world all decide to pool their resources and allow Yan Xu to use their eight jade swords to locate the ninth. He performs a secret technique and the superpowers head off after the swords towards the Qian Long continent.

After arriving at the Qian Long continent following the eight Jade swords in their possession, Qin Yu along with the other superpowers head straight to the Wilderness in search of the ninth Jade sword. However with the swords seemingly not working any longer as guides, the six superpowers decide to take up residence in the Qian Long continent while they send for reinforcements to help search for the ninth Jade sword. This gives Qin Yu the opportunity to visit his family in the Qin Dynasty for the first time in the ten years since he left. What should've been a happy occasion for Qin Yu only turns into anger after he discovers that his first master, Zhao Yunxing has been murdered and that both Qin De and Feng Yuzi had an arm cut off by Dongfang Yu. Qin Yu discovers that Dongfang Yu is staying in the Ming Dynasty and goes seeking revenge. With Yan Lang running interference, Qin Yu, Hei Yu, Hou Fei and the 10,000 Stellar Tower guards wipe out Chaoyang forces on the Qian Long continent and capture Dongfang Yu before Qin Yu also orders that the Chaoyang School is completely wiped out too and Qin Yu returns to the Qin Dynasty while his forces continue to search the Wilderness for the ninth Jade box. Having decided it was a good opportunity to visit his childhood friends, Qin Yu goes to visit his childhood friends Xiao Lu and Tie Shan and while catching up, happens to save Xun Feng from the wrath of Situ Xue. Which leads to the confession from Yi Da that they've found the location where the ninth Jade box is. The six superpowers overcome some tribulations in order to enter a room, sitting within the room holding the ninth Jade sword is Yan Mo who fondly welcomes his guests and introduces himself as the ruler of the outermost third of the Wilderness.

Qin Yu along with the other superpowers start to negotiate with Yan Mo who makes it clear that he wants to enter the Immortal Mansion along with them. However the negotiation takes a turn when it's declared that each sword will only allow two people to enter. Yan Mo who has the ninth Jade sword murders the representatives of the Nine Demons Hall and takes their sword increasing the number of his subordinates he can take with him. They all agree that they will meet at Green Tree Island and embark on their journey to the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion from there in three and a half years. Qin Yu who has been at the peak of the meteor stage undergoes his 6-in-9 Heavenly tribulation within three years to go before the trip to the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion. However Di Nai, the last remaining member of the Nine Demons Hall, has set up Specter, an assassin organisation with the express intent to get revenge on Qin Yu and Hou Fei by assassinating members of the Qin Dynasty Royal Family,it attacks Qin Yu as he's about to undergo his six tribulation. A tribulation the magnitude of which the world has never seen. Despite Hou Fei being on guard and destroying Di Nai's body, he uses his yuanying to pierce Qin Yu's chest causing Qin Yu to lose focus which leads to the destruction of Flaming Sword and gloves. [Noooooo!!]. However despite exchanging his life for the opportunity to mess up Qin Yu's tribulation, Qin Yu emerges victorious. Having undergone his tribulation Qin Yu reaches the Early Core Stage and with his new power, is eligible to use many of the top grade crystals that Lei Wei amassed in the Lei Mountain House to create a Black Origin weapon. Armed with his Black Origin weapon and with Jiang Li in tow, along with the other super powers which now includes Yan Mo of the wilderness, they embark on their journey into Chaotic Astral Ocean and head towards the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion. The group is quickly attacked by ferobeasts who manage to injure Yan Lang, Yi Da and Yan Mo and just as they desperately reach the mansion that manages to save them, Three-Eyes, Xue Nu and Hong Luan are murdered by a mysterious black light.

After the black light materialised, Qin Yu discovered that the light was actually two brothers Huo Can and Huo Lou. After some discussion, the Huo brothers were permitted to join the others in entering the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion. Once they get in, they find out that the master of the mansion, Ni Yang had set up many tests, the first that they'd have to overcome was the Hallucinatory Magic Land. While Qin Yu puts up a brave fight, he eventually succumbs to the Hallucinatory Magic Land and is forced to relive the battle that he faced against Wu Xing and Wu De. Luckily for Qin Yu, with the Meteoric Tear minimizing the effects he was facing, Jiang Li eventually saves him and Qin Yu, Jiang Li and the others are whisked away. The group is forced to undergo Ni Yang's second trial, a choice between a Peach Blossom Land and a Road of Death. Qin Yu, Jiang Li, Yan Ji, Yan Mo, Gan Xu, Huo Can, Yi Da and Yang Lan all chose the Road of Death and are transported to the Qingyu Immortal Mansion, the inner mansion of the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion and the location of the treasures. Qin Yu is able to acquire two holy beast collars, writing brushes and an ink wash painting that turns out to be a Heaven Sundering Diagram from within the mansion. Having plundered the Nine Swords Immortal Mansion of its treasures, the group are teleported back to Golden Tree Island and as Qin Yu is making his way back to the Qian Long Continent. The ring he managed to secretly get before entering the Qingyu Immortal Mansion is revealed to be the Lord of Black Flame's Ring. Qin Yu uses the opportunity to reach the Planet Stage that provides him a Solar Core before taking Jiang Li take to tour the Qian Long Continent. While Qin Yu and Jiang Li are out they run into Zhou Xian in Guishui City within the Ming Dynasty. Zhou Xian informs Jiang Li that she must return to her clan under order of the King of the clan and then wantonly slaughters the residents of the city before being stopped by Jiang Lan. Jiang Lan informs Qin Yu that he must return to be with Jiang Li and leaves Qin Yu a Sword Immortal Puppet that contains a Heaven-Sundering Sword Art. Lian Chong who had been hunted down by a mysterious 10th level loose immortal (people who failed but survived lightning tribulations) and had expended his energy and treasures, had just finished making his final farewells to his family when Qin Yu is kind enough to offer him an Eternal Creation Pill which enabled him to regain his energy in order to undertake the final bolts of lightning. Hu Yi and Lian Xiao, the parents of Lian Chong, offer Qin Yu all and any of their treasures in gratitude for saving their son, but Qin Yu settles for a chunk of Low Quality Elemental Ore before leaving the island to meet up with Hei Yu and Hou Fei who had just undergone their 9-in-9 tribulations. On the return journey, Qin Yu manages to reach the Middle Dujie Stage and happens across Shi Xin, Shi Bing and Shi Zhan. Qin Yu intended to make the Shi brothers the magical beast mounts of him and his two sworn brothers but they refuse to submit. Having reunited with Hou Fei and Hei Yu, and finally forcing the Shi brothers to submit, Qin Yu receives a message from Guardian Liang Sheng who informs him that a battle for the ink wash painting he left in his Qin Zheng's possession had lead to the massacre of most of the royal family and had left the capital city of the Qin Dynasty in rubble, Qin Yu immediately heads for the Teng Long continent. Now armed with the names of his enemies, Qin Yu along with his sworn brothers Hou Fei and Hei Yu and their respective magical beasts, heads for the Teng Long continent to exact his revenge.

characters.title: Lian Yan
characters.introText: Lian Yan, affectionately known as Grandpa Lian, was a highly trusted senior retainer of the Qin Clan and the primary caretaker of Qin Yu during his childhood. Having lived for over a hundred years, he was not only a loyal servant but also served as a fiercely protective father figure to the young protagonist.
characters.personality: Despite his official status as an employee of the Qin Clan, Lian Yan’s personality was overwhelmingly warm, patient, and deeply fatherly. While Qin De was emotionally distant and entirely focused on preparing for the impending rebellion, Grandpa Lian provided the emotional anchor and familial love that Qin Yu desperately needed. However, beneath his gentle demeanor lay a deeply buried desire for vengeance against the Chu Dynasty (Xiang Clan) for past tragedies inflicted upon his loved ones.
characters.history:
Entrusted by Qin De, Lian Yan managed Misty Villa (Qingwu Villa), the secluded estate where Qin Yu was sent to live due to his inability to practice internal cultivation. For years, Lian Yan watched over the boy, providing guidance, emotional support, and overseeing his daily life during his brutal external cultivation training. He was one of the very few people who truly believed in Qin Yu's potential and sheer willpower.

Lian Yan harbored a lifelong grudge against Yi Qingyu, an elite Chu Dynasty assassin responsible for murdering Lian Yan's family decades prior. His chance for revenge finally arrived during a complex, multi-layered trap orchestrated by the Chu Emperor.

Desperate for strategic resources to fight the Qin Clan, Emperor Xiang Guang arranged a massive transaction with a merchant named Zhu San, offering one of the legendary Trans-Heaven Diagrams (Tongtian Tu) in exchange for demonic beast parts (the Sabertooth Tiger). However, this deal was deliberately staged near Qin territory as bait. When the Qin Clan, led personally by Lian Yan, moved to intercept the convoy commanded by Yi Feng (Yi Qingyu's son), they walked directly into the Emperor's true trap: a secondary ambush led by Yi Qingyu, who had been secretly deployed to annihilate the Qin interceptors.

Facing his lifelong nemesis in the midst of this double-ambush, Lian Yan engaged in a brutal, all-out duel. Pushing past his physical limits, Lian Yan successfully killed Yi Qingyu, fulfilling his decades-long vengeance, but sustained fatal injuries in the process.

Qin Yu arrived at the scene just in time to witness Grandpa Lian's dying moments. Enraged and heartbroken by the loss of his father figure, Qin Yu unleashed his full power, slaughtering the remaining Chu forces and personally executing Yi Feng. Lian Yan's tragic death cemented a permanent turning point in Qin Yu's martial journey, stripping away his remaining innocence and solidifying his absolute hatred for the Xiang Clan.

characters.history:
Born on 1st of January, year 9982 of the Yulan calendar.

Linley Baruch was born on the Yulan Plane to the

declining Baruch Clan. As a youth, his father teaches him the history of their Dragonblood Clan and obtains the Coiling Dragon Ring which had the spirit of Doehring Cowart.

Doehring Cowart teaches him earth element spells and the single chisel sculpting technique which would enhance his development rate. Linley attended the Ernst Institute and while in school he would meet his future wife Delia. At the time Linley was not involved with Delia and instead formed a relationship with a girl named Alice who attended a different institute.

Linley fights against six Four-Winged Angels and Osenno, killing the Angels and forcing Osenno to flee. Three days later Linley formed the Baruch Duchy he then asks Delia to marry him.

After having entered the Necropolis of the Gods and clearing the eleventh floor all by himself, Linley managed to acquire three Divine Sparks as well as a multitude of Divine Artifacts and weapons.

After having trained for another five and a half years, Linley finally managed to reach the Deity level and produced a Wind-style Demigod Divine Spark. He then allowed a Divine Clone to be formed outside of his body instead of fusing with the Spark himself. This clone can then merge with his original body and enter his soulspace. There were now both his sword-shaped soul and his Divine Clone, dressed in a light green robe, floating inside his soulspace. His clone had a divine body, whereas he himself still had a comparatively weaker body.

While he was training at Mount Copper Gong under the guidance of Leylin, he finally had a breakthrough in the Profound Laws of Earth and produced an Earth-style Demigod Divine Spark. He then decided he wanted to continue to train in other Profound Laws and let the Earth-style Demigod Divine Spark create his second Divine Clone.

In the year 10092 of the Yulan calendar, during late autumn, Linley, Delia, and Bebe headed for the Higher Planes, specifically the Infernal Realm, leaving the Yulan Plane behind.

Once they arrived at the Infernal Realm, they were transported to the Nightblaze Prefecture of the Redbud Continent. After training for a while, Linley managed to breakthrough with his Earth Divine Clone to the Full God level.

After the escort mission failed, Linley, Delia, and Bebe decided to stay in the mountain range where the mission was halted and trained. After a year of training, Linley finally managed a breakthrough in the Profound Laws of Fire and created his Fire Divine Clone.

Once arrived at the Indigo Prefecture of the Bloodridge Continent, Linley and his group instantly made their way towards the Skyrite Mountains, the last residence of the Four Divine Beast Clan, the roots of Linley's Baruch Clan.

After his centuries-long journey, Linley was finally able to meet his Baruch Clan's Ancestors at the outermost border of the Skyrite Mountains. After having trained for another sixty years while living at the Yulan Branch of the Redding Clan, Linley finally was able to make his Divine Fire Clone attain the level of a full God.

After completing the Ancestral Baptism of the Redding Clan, Linley instantly attained a Water-style Demigod Divine Clone as well as the innate ability Dragon Roar.

After displaying his power to be on par with a Seven Star Fiend, Linley was granted the rank of Elder by the Patriarch of the Redding Clan. Linley became the youngest and the 36th Elder of the Assembly of Elders.

A few decades after return from Bloodbath Gorge, Linley managed to breakthrough the Full God level with his Divine Water Clone, resulting in him now having 4 DIvine Clones all on the Full God level.

While he and Delia were on a trip to Meer City, Delia told him that she was pregnant, to which Linley decided to remain there for some time. Inside that city, their third child and second son, Wade Baruch, was born.

At the time when a Sovereign of Destruction intervened and stopped the war between the Four Divine Beast Clan and the Eight Great Clans, Linley suddenly made a breakthrough and became an Earth Highgod, much to the surprise of everyone present, even the almighty Sovereign.

A hundred years after Linley had become an Earth Highgod, Beirut fulfilled his promise and gave Linley the finished Godspark sword, Mirage.

After having been in the Infernal Realm for over 2000 years, Linley and his group finally returned to the Yulan Plane.

After learning from Beirut that there is a chance of returning the death whose soul wasn't destroyed by going to the Netherworld, Linley and Bebe set off on their way to the Nether Realm. While watching a fight at the bottom of the Abyssal Mountain in the Netherworld, Linley suddenly gained an insight into the Profound Laws of Water and became a Water Highgod.

He was given the option of participating in the Planar Wars and kill opposing commanders. in doing so, the Chief Sovereign of Death would grant him his wish of returning his loved ones back to the world of the living.

After he defeated the previous Redcliff Lord, one of the Lords of Tartarus, Linley was bestowed upon the title of Redcliff Lord and Lord of Tartarus, a title equalling Commanders of Purgatory and Lord Prefects. During his participation at the Planar Wars, Linley's Wind Divine Clone managed to breakthrough to the Highgod level, resulting in Linley having 3 Highgod Divine Clones.

After he suffered from the mighty soul attack from the Paragon, Linley had been in a coma for 34 years. After he awakened, his soul had successfully mutated, turning Linley in the first ever 4-way Soul Mutate in the Coiling Dragon Universe. Roughly ten years after his reawakening and turning into a 4-way Soul Mutate, Linley managed to completely repair the Coiling Dragon Ring.

After several more centuries of training, Linley finally broke through with his Fire Clone and became Fire Highgod as well, now has a total of 4 Highgod Clones.

After having collected two out of three Overgod talismans needed for the Overgod mission, Linley chased after the final talisman which was hidden in the Okerlund Plane. In the end, he managed to force Clementine to hand over the Red Caltrop Diamond. With this, he summoned the Overgod of Life and completed the Overgod mission, obtaining an Overgod Artifact, the Life Overgod Sword.

After this, Beirut and Bluefire let Linley and Bebe towards the Necropolis of the Gods in the South Sea. Once they entered straight into the 18th floor, Beirut uncovered the secret behind the Necropolis of the Gods. Afterward, Beirut gave Linley a Water and an Earth-style Sovereign Spark. After fusing with them, Linley had become the first fusion Sovereign since the creation of the universe.

Linley then spent 5000 years creating the first-ever fusion-Sovereign Divine Plane. After Linley enacted his revenge upon Teresia and fused with his Lesser Wind Sovereign Spark, Linley's power again had a tremendous increase as he now was in possession of three Lesser Sovereign Clones.

Linley was later tricked by Augusta telling him he would free his mother in exchange for the blood essence of the Four Divine Beast Sovereigns. Later, when Wodred explained to him that Augusta hadn't actually freed his mother, as a means of thanking him for his contribution in the Planar Wars, he went off to the Divine Light Plane to finish Augusta off.

Linley Confronts Augusta and they have a heated battle then when Augusta uses the fused divine ability of the Four Divine Beasts Linley along with the other Sovereigns present find out that August and Orloff are the same person.

Orloff, enraged by Augusta's demise, charges after Linley and reveals that he, in fact, is in possession of three Overgod Artifacts. Linley is desperately trying to flee but gets cornered by the peak High Sovereign of Fate. In his despair, Linley reaches out to one of the spectating Lesser Fire Sovereigns, Borte, and takes his Sovereign Spark after killing him in one hit. After fusing, he suddenly finds an immeasurable power surging within him and witnesses his four Lesser Sovereign Clones merge with his original body.

Linley with this new found power kills Orloff with his most powerful attack "Sword Intent", which ends up breaking through the bindings of the universe transporting Linley to a region outside of the cosmos called Hongmeng Grandmist, where Linley then meets Hongmeng.

characters.title: Liu Hanshu
characters.introText: Liu Han Shu, often referred to as Han Shu, is a son of the main family of the Liu Clan, one of the three great houses found on the planet, Amber Moon. He is Qin Yu's first disciple and also the first person Qin Yu interacts with in the Immortal Realm. When first introduced he had very little talent due to very weak and thin spiritual channels, though through his master's help he had his channels rebuilt which both widened and strengthened them.
characters.appearance:
After successfully being accepted as a disciple by Qin Yu, Han Shu got respect wherever he  went in the city which resulted in his arrogance started slacking in cultivation. Qin Yu noticed this and greatly reprimanded him and gave Han Shu another chance to improve. Han Shu fell in love with a girl named Lin Lin, it was later found that Lin Lin is the granddaughter of Hidden Emperor Lin Yin.

After Qin Yu killed the disciples of Jade Sword School, immortal emperor went to capture Qin Yu under the orders of sovereign Yu. For laying a trap for Qin Yu, a Level 8 Golden Immortal pressured Han Shu to betray Qin Yu otherwise he would kill his clan members. Han Shu didn't betray Qin Yu and ate a poison fruit which led his miserable death.

After discovering the tragic end of Han Shu by noticing the broken jade slip, Qin Yu enraged and killed at-least 200 golden immortals and fought against immortal emperors.

The death of Han Shu greatly affected Qin Yu as he hid his true strength from his disciple. If his disciple knew his true strength he might not have foolishly chose his death, this is one of the greatest regrets of Qin Yu.
characters.personality: Due to his below average strength, Han Shu had to live his life in fear of everyone as he ranked at the bottom of the social hierarchy on his planet. Even though he was a part of one of the three great houses on the planet most anyone could boss him around. This leads him to have two distinct personality traits of being very submissive in front of people and very hard working when he was alone so that he could become stronger. This latter trait was also help by the fact that his father was very strict with him and made him train for at least half of the day.
characters.history: Some time in the past before his appearance in the story his mother was killed above a lake that sits beside Liu Feng city, one of the three largest cities of Amber Moon, this lakeside is then a place he would come when he was sad as a way for him to talk to his mother. His mother at the time of her death was a Kongming stage expert but even still she was killed by another Kongming stage expert. Han Shu seems to think that if his mother was still alive he would have lived a better life. When he is first introduced, Han Shu is 25 years old and is at the Middle Jindan Stage. While this would be considered genius level talent in the mortal world, in the immortal world where he was born and still lives it is very below average. Here babies are born at the level of Peak Houtain Stage and will generally reach Early Jinan Stage at 5. By the age of 10, they will reach early Yuanying stage but Han Shu is still a rank lower than them.

characters.personality:
Qin De, as one of the great nobles of the Chu Dynasty and the patriarch of one of the Four Great Clans, embodied the very essence of a true lord. He possessed a commanding presence, both majestic and composed, with the natural mind of a strategist and the discipline of a seasoned military commander. As a ruler, he was wise and precise; as a father, he was deeply caring and devoted.

His affection for his children was always clear, and his dedication to family shaped the strong bonds between his sons. The unity and mutual respect among the Qin brothers were a reflection of the values instilled by their father.

Qin De took immense pride in his lineage and was a passionate advocate for restoring the Qin family to imperial prominence. The tragic death of his wife, Jing Yi, drove him to further refine and accelerate his plans for rebellion against the Chu Dynasty. But it was the presumed death of his son that became the breaking point that led Qin De to raise the banner of revolution.

characters.title: Qin Feng
characters.introText: He Was The First Prince (or First Young Master) of Qin Clan, Comander of Fierce Tiger Army, and later General of the Qin Dynasty (Zulong), And later The Supreme First Elder.
characters.personality:
Among the three Qin brothers, while Qin Zheng was the mind and Qin Yu the young and innocent spirit, Qin Feng was undoubtedly the muscle. In the beginning of Qin Yu’s journey, Qin Feng stood out as the strongest among them. Naturally drawn to military matters, he was deeply involved in training and leading the Qin Clan’s forces. His dedication and prowess eventually earned him the title of General of the new Qin Dynasty, overseeing and commanding the empire’s armies, despite being the eldest brother.

It is important to highlight a defining trait of the Qin Clan: the deep affection shared among its members. Qin Feng’s bond with his younger brother, Qin Yu, was marked by genuine care and protection. This profound loyalty ensured that Qin Feng never harbored hostility or envy, even as his younger siblings rose to positions of immense power and influence — with Qin Zheng becoming emperor and Qin Yu ascending to legendary status. Qin Feng’s unwavering heart remained a cornerstone of the Qin family's unity.
characters.history:
Moreover, an event from Qin Feng’s youth marked a dark chapter in his life. As a child, he had hidden inside his mother Jing Yi’s wardrobe and witnessed her assassination firsthand. The fire that later engulfed their residence had been staged to conceal the truth — that her death was no accident, but a deliberate murder. Qin Feng survived only because his uncle, Feng Yuzi, managed to rescue him from the flames. The truth of what had happened was carried by Qin Feng to his father

Due to his deep interest in military affairs, Qin Feng became a vital asset in the plans to overthrow the Chu Dynasty. He played a key role in preparing the troops and personally led the elite forces of the clan — the Fierce Tiger Army — a battalion of highly trained warriors mounted on tigers.

Following the rise of the Qin Dynasty, Qin Feng was elevated to a high rank general, entrusted with the supervision and training of the imperial army. His efforts proved crucial, as the dynasty would soon face numerous conflicts, including the siege of the capital, Yan Jing City, by formidable enemies. In those dire times, Feng’s leadership and the readiness of his troops became decisive factors for the dynasty’s survival.

It is worth noting that Feng eventually married and, as Qin Zheng often joked, was "tamed" by his wife. After the brutal battles against the Golden Immortals, Feng and his kin turned their focus toward cultivation. Through relentless effort, he not only advanced through the cultivation realms but ultimately ascended to the Immortal Realm.

In the Immortal Realm, Qin Feng was reunited with his brother Qin Yu. Even after millennia had passed, Qin Feng remained one of the enduring pillars of the Qin Clan — steadfast and unwavering in his loyalty and strength.

characters.title: Qin Zheng
characters.introText: He Was The Second Prince (or Second Young Master) of Qin Clan. The first Qin Emperor of the Qin Dynasty (Zulong), And later The Supreme Second Elder.
characters.personality:
Among the three Qin brothers, Qin Zheng was always the most composed and intelligent. A gifted administrator from a young age, he aided in clan affairs with a sharp mind and steady hand. Known as the “wise brother,” his talents and noble character led him to ascend as Emperor of the Qin Dynasty — despite being the second son.

It is worth noting the deep bonds within the Qin family. Qin De’s love and devotion to his sons is undeniable — a father who truly cherishes his children. Equally admirable is the harmony among the brothers, who never showed hostility toward one another. Instead, they supported and protected each other, especially their youngest, lovingly known as “Little Yu.”
characters.history:
Though Qin Zheng was more inclined toward administrative matters than martial pursuits, his role within the clan was crucial. As a brilliant strategist and steadfast ally to his father, he was instrumental during the rebellion against the Chu Dynasty. Following Chu's fall, Qin Zheng ascended as Emperor — a position he held throughout the entire mortal realm arc of Qin Yu’s saga, enduring countless trials.

Among these were:

The fierce conflict with the Ming Dynasty, allied with the Chaoyang Sect.

The invasion of Di Nai’s forces — the last remaining brother of the fallen Nine Demon Hall Master.

The catastrophic assault of the Loose Immortals, where many civilians perished, including members of the Qin family — among them, his own son. 	 	 	 		 			 		 		 		 			QIn Zheng and his Son

The climactic battle against emissaries from the Immortal Realm — a force composed of Golden Immortals.

After surviving these trials, Qin Zheng chose to dedicate himself to cultivation — not for power, but to avoid becoming a burden to Qin Yu and to better protect his family and the citizens of the dynasty. It’s important to note: this entire arc spanned over a century.

Qin Zheng’s final appearance came 4,000 years later, upon Qin Yu’s return to the mortal world. By then, the Qin Dynasty had long been abolished. No longer emperor, he now served as the Second Supreme Elder of the Qin Clan — the only member of the original family who had not ascended to the Immortal Realm. His enduring presence speaks volumes of his resilience and unyielding sense of duty. Even after millennia, Qin Zheng remained a pillar of the clan’s survival and legacy.

characters.title: Shangguan Hong
characters.introText: Shangguan Hong was the leader of the Shangguan Clan (the Northern Lords), one of the four Great Clans of the Chu Dynasty
characters.history:
As the ruler of the two Northern counties of the Chu Empire, Shangguan Hong was invited by Qin De to a secret summit to discuss the overthrow of Emperor Xiang Guang. Qin De offered him a highly lucrative deal: if the Shangguan Clan allied with the Qin forces, their sovereign territory would be doubled from two to four counties upon the empire's fall. Driven by greed and political opportunism, Shangguan Hong outwardly accepted the alliance.

However, Shangguan Hong never intended to honor the agreement. He secretly planned to leak the details of the Qin Rebellion directly to Emperor Xiang Guang, expecting to receive a massive reward from the imperial crown for crushing the rebellion before it started.

Unfortunately for him, Qin De had anticipated this exact betrayal. By putting his long-term Flying Eagle Plan into motion, he activated the Three Eagles—a sleeper cell of elite intelligence operatives managed by Xu Yuan that had been infiltrated into the Northern territories years prior. These agents successfully assassinated Shangguan Hong and framed the central government for the murder, using an agent of the Fierce Dragon Corps as a scapegoat.

To ensure the Northern counties would still serve his military objectives, Qin De had his operatives plant fabricated evidence directly within the Northern Lord's own stronghold, perfectly framing Emperor Xiang Guang for the murder. Finding the supposed imperial evidence inside their own capital, the enraged Shangguan Clan officially committed their armies to the Qin Rebellion, becoming a crucial asset in the destruction of the Chu Dynasty.

characters.title: Xiang Guang
characters.introText: Xiang Guang was the final Emperor of the Chu Dynasty (Xiang Clan) and the primary political antagonist during the early stages of the Mortal Realm arc. He is infamous for his deep paranoia, political incompetence, and the fatal decisions that ultimately sparked the Qin Rebellion and the complete destruction of his empire.
characters.personality:
Unlike his ancestors, Xiang Guang was a weak, deeply paranoid, and heavily flawed ruler. He showed little interest in actual governance, instead spending the majority of his time indulging in pleasures with his favorite concubine.

His most defining trait was his overwhelming jealousy and fear of Qin De, the leader of the Qin Clan (the Eastern Lords). Aware that Qin De was vastly more competent, respected, and militarily capable than himself, Xiang Guang allowed his paranoia to dictate his diplomatic decisions. He was known for being arrogant yet cowardly, a combination that alienated his vassals and made him universally despised by his enemies and allies alike.
characters.history:
Driven by his overwhelming paranoia and fear of the Qin Clan's military might, Xiang Guang committed his most devastating mistake. Seeking to emotionally cripple Qin De without triggering an open rebellion, he secretly ordered the assassination of Jing Yi, Qin De's beloved wife. Xiang Guang's agents drove her to her death and deliberately set a fire to frame the tragedy as a mere accident. Xiang Guang believed his treachery was perfectly hidden, unaware that Qin De's eldest son, Qin Feng (who was ten years old at the time), was hidden in the room and witnessed the entire assassination. The exposure of the Emperor's cowardly act forged an unbreakable vow of vengeance within Qin De and his sons

Years later, as Qin De underwent his 4-in-9 Heavenly Tribulation to reach the Jindan (Golden Core) stage, Xiang Guang sent elite Golden Core assassins (Wu Xing and Wu De) to eliminate the Eastern Lord at his most vulnerable moment. During this attack, Qin De was fiercely defended by a mysterious assassin known as "Meteor" (Liu Xing)—who was secretly his own son, Qin Yu, in disguise.

Qin Yu to protect his father, seemingly sacrificing his life in the process. This tragedy served as the final trigger for the immediate launch of the Qin Rebellion. Due to Xiang Guang's tyrannical reputation and paranoid leadership, his vassal states quickly crumbled. The Qin Clan utilized covert maneuvers to execute a pre-existing secret alliance with the Mu Clan and successfully framed the imperial crown for the assassination of the Shangguan Clan's leader. Heavily isolated and betrayed by his own vassals, Xiang Guang's military power collapsed rapidly from the inside out.

As the rebel forces conquered province after province and rapidly advanced toward the imperial capital, the Chu Dynasty's final hope rested on the unexpected return of their ancestor, Xiang Yang. Having secretly reached the Yuanying (Nascent Soul) stage, Xiang Yang's immense power abruptly halted the Qin advance, stabilizing the frontlines and inflicting heavy casualties on the rebel forces.

However, this stabilization was short-lived. Xiang Yang was eventually confronted and killed by Qin Yu and Hei Yu. With their sole Nascent Soul protector dead, the Chu military suffered an absolute collapse, allowing the Qin forces to finally breach Ba Chu County and storm the capital.

When Qin De and his sons entered the throne room to deliver justice, Xiang Guang made a final, pathetic attempt to belittle them out of sheer arrogance. Realizing there was no escape and that his empire was completely destroyed, he chose to commit suicide by drinking poison alongside his lover, marking the end of his life and the total eradication of the Chu Dynasty.
characters.trivia:
The Ultimate Catalyst: Ironically, Xiang Guang's incompetence is the catalyst for the entire plot of Stellar Transformations. Had he not murdered Jing Yi out of paranoid jealousy, Qin De might have delayed the rebellion, and Qin Yu might not have pushed himself to the absolute limits of external cultivation to aid his family.

Donghua Portrayal: In the animation, his depiction heavily leans into the archetype of the "corrupt, pleasure-seeking king." He is constantly seen lounging with his concubine in the throne room, willfully ignoring the desperate military reports of his collapsing empire until it is entirely too late.

In the past, the West Chu Conqueror was extremely overbearing so when contending for the control of the lands he offended very many influential people. After his death, the Xiang clan became everyone’s target. Luckily, young Xiang Yang made an impressive entrance, befriending distant states while attacking the nearby ones. Eventually he and the other 2 great powers divided all the lands into 3.

Afterwards, Xiang Yang managed the Chu kingdom for several decades and even turned it into the strongest of the 3 kingdoms. Not only did Xiang Yang excel at governing the country, according to legend, he was even at least not inferior to his father Xiang Yu when it comes to martial arts. Despite having to pay attention to the running of the country, he was finally still able to reach the Jindan stage.

Xiang Yu was ruthless and totally overbearing but was not benevolent enough. However Xiang Yang seemed to be perfect. Depending on the situation, he could be either benevolent, or ruthless, or fair, or deceitful. He could use all kinds of tricks proficiently and was absolutely a born emperor.

characters.title: Xu Yuan
characters.introText: Working closely with Qin De, Xu Yuan spent his life orchestrating the Flying Eagle Plan (Fei Ying Ji Hua), the Qin Family's massive blueprint to overthrow the Chu Dynasty (Xiang Family). Operating from Yan City, his direct contributions included:
characters.appearance: Geopolitics and Timeline of Unification: The geopolitical complexity of the continent varies significantly across adaptations. In the donghua (animation), the political landscape is heavily condensed, giving the impression that the continent was either already unified under the Chu Dynasty (with the Qin Family simply inheriting it) or that it was practically unified immediately after Chu's fall. In contrast, both the original web novel and the manhua (comic) explicitly establish that the continent was divided into a prolonged stalemate among three major powers (the Qin, Han, and Ming Dynasties).
characters.history:
Working closely with Qin De, Xu Yuan spent his life orchestrating the Flying Eagle Plan (Fei Ying Ji Hua), the Qin Family's massive blueprint to overthrow the Chu Dynasty (Xiang Family). Operating from Yan City, his direct contributions included:

The Northern Lord False Flag Operation: Xu Yuan managed the "Three Eagles"—deep-cover sleeper agents planted in the Northern region. He coordinated the assassination of the Northern Lord using operatives disguised as the Chu Emperor's forces, successfully sparking a rebellion that split the enemy's military focus.

Intelligence Processing: While the martial Elders led the Heavenly Net assassins in the field, Xu Yuan was the central hub for all gathered intelligence, constantly countering the Xiang Family's Spider Web spy network and managing troop deployments.

The Qian Long continent was historically divided among three major powers: the Chu, Han, and Ming Dynasties. Following the collapse of the Chu Dynasty, the Qian Long continent did not immediately unify. The territory fractured into three major powers: the Qin, Han, and Ming Dynasties. The Qin Family did not immediately unify the continent; instead, they claimed the Chu territories, establishing the Qin Dynasty and maintaining the three-way geopolitical stalemate against the pre-existing Han and Ming.

As Qin De stepped back from politics to focus on martial cultivation—taking the honorary title of Supreme Emperor—his second son, Qin Zheng, ascended the throne. Xu Yuan was appointed as the first Prime Minister of the Qin Dynasty, tasked with guiding the young emperor through the complex cold war and border skirmishes against the remaining two empires.

Years later, Qin Yu returned to the Qian Long Continent he discovers the situation of The Qin dynasty, becoming immersed in the empire's plight and family tragedies, and thus decides to launch a retaliatory attack against the Chaoyang sect (allied with the Ming dynasty). This intervention crippled the Ming Dynasty, and later the support of the Han dynasty. As Prime Minister, Xu Yuan capitalized on their severely weakened state, managing the strategic and administrative campaigns that eventually led to their conquest, finally achieving the complete unification of the Qian Long continent under the Qin banner.

Geopolitics and Timeline of Unification: The geopolitical complexity of the continent varies significantly across adaptations. In the donghua (animation), the political landscape is heavily condensed, giving the impression that the continent was either already unified under the Chu Dynasty (with the Qin Family simply inheriting it) or that it was practically unified immediately after Chu's fall. In contrast, both the original web novel and the manhua (comic) explicitly establish that the continent was divided into a prolonged stalemate among three major powers (the Qin, Han, and Ming Dynasties).

Xue Yun is the Blood Sea Queen, an ancient and extremely powerful Godking in the Divine Realm. Her true form is the endless Blood Sea itself, a mysterious existence that was born alongside the Divine Realm. Because of this origin, she possesses an incredibly durable body, immense vitality, and defensive abilities far beyond ordinary Godkings.

She is recognized as one of the strongest experts beneath the Asura Godking, with her strength feared throughout the Divine Realm. Xue Yun also commands the legendary Blood Slaves, special servants created from fallen Godkings. These Blood Slaves are extremely difficult to destroy and serve as one of the Blood Sea Palace’s greatest sources of power.

Xue Yun has a proud, domineering, and commanding personality. She controls enormous amounts of blood-colored sea water capable of covering massive regions such as Exalted Celestial Mountain and even parts of the surrounding Asura Sea. During battle, she uses overwhelming pressure and battlefield control to suppress opponents.

Her weapon is the Blood Trident, a second-rate Grandmist Spiritual Treasure that has been nourished and strengthened using her own Origin Energy for countless years. Because of this, the Blood Trident becomes far more dangerous when wielded by her compared to ordinary users.
characters.personality:
Xue Yun is proud, domineering, and highly confident in her own strength. As one of the oldest Godkings in the Divine Realm, she usually treats others with an attitude of superiority and rarely fears confrontation. She is capable of acting ruthlessly when necessary and does not hesitate to kill powerful experts if it benefits her goals.

At the same time, she is not reckless. Xue Yun is very cautious and intelligent, often hiding her true strength and avoiding unnecessary risks. During ancient conflicts, she intentionally concealed much of her power instead of becoming the center of attention like the Asura Godking.

Although feared by many people, she is still capable of negotiation and compromise when it benefits her interests. She has shown respect toward Qin Yu’s talent and strength and was even willing to cooperate with him at certain points.

Beneath her cold and dominant exterior, traces of her older personality still remain. According to Jiang Lan, Xue Yun was once a quiet and pure girl in the distant past before becoming the feared Blood Sea Queen known throughout the Divine Realm.
characters.history:
Xue Yun is an ancient existence who has lived since the early eras of the Divine Realm. Her history suggests she participated in major events and cosmic conflicts, including battles connected to Exalted Celestial Mountain.

For countless years, she maintained influence from within the Blood Sea Palace while carefully protecting her territory and expanding her power. Much of her actions revolve around preserving her dominance, obtaining powerful treasures, and defending the interests of the Blood Sea Palace.

She also became involved in the struggle surrounding the All People Seal, which brought her into conflict and negotiation with several top-tier experts of the Divine Realm.

Despite her ruthless reputation, Xue Yun is not completely unreasonable. On several occasions, she has negotiated with enemies, spared lives in exchange for benefits, and formed temporary alliances when it suited her interests. Even so, she remains one of the most feared and dangerous Godkings in the Divine Realm.

characters.title: Zhao Yunxing
characters.introText: Zhao Yunxing is a highly respected general of the Qin Clan, the commander of the elite Fierce Tiger Army, and the strict external cultivation master of Qin Yu. He played a fundamental role in shaping the protagonist's combat foundation, mental resilience, and physical endurance during his childhood at Misty Villa.
characters.appearance: Adaptation Differences (The Execution): In the Web Novel and Manhua, Qin Yu captures Dongfang Yu alive to be executed by Qin De as a sacrifice to Zhao Yunxing. However, the Donghua heavily censors this sequence; Qin Yu merely defeats Dongfang Yu, and the lethal blow is ultimately delivered by the demonic cultivator Yan Lang.
characters.personality: Zhao Yunxing is defined by his ironclad military discipline, stoic demeanor, and unyielding loyalty to Qin De. As a teacher, he practiced "tough love," pushing Qin Yu to the absolute brink of physical exhaustion and refusing to show pity or coddle the young prince. Despite his brutal training methods, he possessed deep respect for Qin Yu’s unnatural willpower and growth. He viewed martial arts and external cultivation not as a hobby, but as a battlefield survival necessity.
characters.history:
When Qin Yu was rejected for internal cultivation training, Qin De hired Zhao Yunxing to teach the boy external martial arts at Misty Villa. Zhao Yunxing warned that external cultivation was a path of pure suffering, but accepted the task. For a year, he subjected Qin Yu to hellish physical conditioning—including running with heavy weights, enduring extreme temperatures, and mastering various weapon arts. Witnessing Qin Yu's legendary determination, Zhao Yunxing passed down his ultimate techniques before leaving to resume his military duties, forging a deep lifelong bond of respect between master and disciple.

During the Qin Rebellion against the Chu Dynasty, Zhao Yunxing led the elite Fierce Tiger Army on the frontlines, securing crucial tactical victories for Qin De's forces. He survived the brutal war of unification. Following the complete collapse of the Chu Dynasty and the founding of the new Qin Dynasty, Zhao Yunxing was promoted to the rank of Great General, becoming one of the most powerful and influential military officials in the newly unified empire.

Decades after the founding of the Qin Dynasty, the Qianlong Continent's power balance was drastically altered. Factions connected to the highly advanced Overseas Cultivation World (Penglai Immortal Region) began to interfere in mortal politics. The rival Ming Dynasty, backed by the powerful Chaoyang Sect—a faction possessing true cultivators whose powers far exceeded the mortal Golden Core stage—launched a devastating war against the Qin Dynasty.

Despite his tactical brilliance and having broken through to the Xiantian stage, General Zhao Yunxing was fundamentally a mortal martial artist. Against the overwhelming supernatural power of the Chaoyang Sect's cultivators, mortal armies were completely outmatched. During the conflict, Zhao Yunxing was tragically killed in battle by a high-ranking cultivator named Dongfang Yu. The war also resulted in severe casualties for the Qin royal family, with Qin De and Feng Yuzi both losing an arm in combat.

Qin Vs Chaoyang Sect

Zhao Yunxing's death deeply impacted the Qin Clan. When Qin Yu eventually returned to the mortal continent and discovered the fate of his revered master, his retaliation was absolute. He systematically hunted down and destroyed the Chaoyang Sect. However, he did not kill his master's murderer immediately. Instead, Qin Yu captured Dongfang Yu alive and brought him back to the Qin capital, presenting him to Qin De so that Dongfang Yu could be personally executed before General Zhao Yunxing's memorial.

While Zhao Yunxing’s death was avenged, Qin Yu's massive retaliation had severe geopolitical consequences. During this confrontation with the Ming Dynasty and the cultivation sect, Qin Yu's identity as a prince of the Qin Dynasty is revealed. The world of cultivation operated on an unwritten rule: powerful cultivators were forbidden from overtly interfering in mortal imperial conflicts. By publicly slaughtering the Chaoyang Sect and using his overwhelming cultivation power to force the Ming Dynasty into submission, Qin Yu blurred the lines of this rule. Although justified as "personal retaliation," this display of force effectively removed the mortal protections surrounding the Qin Dynasty, turning his family into legitimate targets for future, far more dangerous cultivation factions and Loose Immortals.

cultivation.title: Loose Immortal
cultivation.introText: The Loose Immortal (散仙), Loose Devil (散魔), or Loose Demon (散妖) stage represents an alternative, and often more arduous, path to immortality in the Stellar Transformation universe. Cultivators typically enter this realm when they fail to fully ascend after undergoing their Heavenly Tribulation at the Dacheng stage (or sometimes even earlier stages like Dujie). Instead of perishing, their physical body is destroyed, but their soul manages to escape, becoming a 'loose' cultivator.
cultivation.appearance:
The Loose Immortal (散仙), Loose Devil (散魔), or Loose Demon (散妖) stage represents an alternative, and often more arduous, path to immortality in the Stellar Transformation universe. Cultivators typically enter this realm when they fail to fully ascend after undergoing their Heavenly Tribulation at the Dacheng stage (or sometimes even earlier stages like Dujie). Instead of perishing, their physical body is destroyed, but their soul manages to escape, becoming a 'loose' cultivator.

Unlike regular Immortals who ascend directly, Loose Cultivators must endure a series of additional Heavenly Tribulations, each more potent than the last. There are a total of 12 such tribulations they must overcome to fully stabilize their cultivation and reach the pinnacle of this unique path. Each successful tribulation grants them immense power and brings them closer to true immortal status.

Their progression through these tribulations directly corresponds to the power levels of Heavenly Immortals:

Upon successfully passing their 12th Heavenly Tribulation, a Loose Immortal's strength rivals that of a peak Level 9 Heavenly Immortal, allowing them to finally shed their "loose" status and officially enter the ranks of Golden Immortals in the Immortal Realm. Despite the extreme dangers and the pain of repeated tribulations, this path grants them an extraordinary lifespan of 100,000,000 (One Hundred Million) years.

cultivation.title: Preliminary Deity
cultivation.introText: The Preliminary Deity stage marks the transitional phase between peak Immortal power and the beginning of true godhood in the Divine Realm. Only cultivators who have reached Level 9 Mystic Immortaland successfully overcome the Divine Tribulation can qualify for this stage.
cultivation.appearance:
The Preliminary Deity stage marks the transitional phase between peak Immortal power and the beginning of true godhood in the Divine Realm. Only cultivators who have reached Level 9 Mystic Immortaland successfully overcome the Divine Tribulation can qualify for this stage.

Upon triumphing over the final tribulation, the cultivator ascends to the Divine Realm and undergoes a sacred rite at the Ascension Pool, where the divine power of the realm infuses their body. This baptism eradicates all remaining Immortal Essence within them and replaces it entirely with Divine Power, which begins to accumulate and condense within the dantian.

At this stage, the individual is no longer considered a mortal-based lifeform, but they also have not yet formed a stable Divine Core or soul-level transformation necessary to reach true godhood. Their soul and divine power remain unstable and embryonic, requiring an exceptionally long period of cultivation to mature.

If provided with sufficient Divine Spirit Stones or other divine resources, a Preliminary Deity may—after tens of millions of years —develop their soul to the Divine Core  stage, thereby entering the ranks of a Deity.

This stage is often seen as a trial phase or bottleneck, where time, resources, and comprehension of divine law determine whether one can truly step into the realm of gods.

cultivation.title: Universe Creator
cultivation.introText: A Grandmist Controller possesses Omnipotent omnipresent omniscience over all cosmic information, can calculate the destiny of any individual, and can harness the energy of any universe. Their own universe's lowest layer contains over ten million mortal universes, with an area thousands of times larger than the middle layer. The middle layer consists of over ten thousand higher dimensions, and the highest layer is the Divine Realm.
cultivation.personality: A Grandmist Controller’s strength is directly tied to the size and development of their Cosmos. Larger Cosmoses grant greater control, stronger abilities, and deeper influence over reality itself.
cultivation.trivia:
Every Hongmeng Controller adopts the suffix "Meng" at the end of their name upon achieving this rank. For example, when Qin Yu became a Hongmeng Controller, he took the name Qin Meng.

ST - Grandmist Controller

Once the Cosmos is finished they become the ruler of their own cosmos.

In Stellar Transformations, parallel universes form the foundation of existence. At the origin of all creation lies the Hongmeng Space, a boundless primordial expanse from which the first being, Hongmeng, was born. Over countless eons, Hongmeng created the first great universe—the Hongmeng Universe. After more than 1,000 epoch (one epoch  equals six quadrillion years), a powerful figure named Lin Meng was born within this universe. He cultivated the legendary Hongmeng Body and, through overwhelming force, broke through the membrane of the Hongmeng Universe, entering the Hongmeng Space itself. There, under the guidance of Hongmeng, Lin Meng created the Lin Meng Universe.

Two epoch later, Qin Yu was born within the Lin Meng Universe. While developing his self-created cultivation technique, Stellar Transformations, Qin Yu established a connection to the Hongmeng Space and gradually perfected his own universe. In this cosmology, those capable of creating entire universes stand above destiny—they are beings whose fates cannot be calculated by any means.
Hongmeng Golden List

As the Hongmeng Space is infinite and ever-expanding, the emergence of new universes is inevitable. To govern this cosmic growth, the Hongmeng Golden List was naturally birthed by the Hongmeng Space itself. It records and empowers those who reach the apex of cultivation: the Hongmeng Controllers.

Individuals listed on the Hongmeng Golden List gain the ability to calculate the destinies of nearly all lifeforms and manipulate the energy of any universe. However, to maintain balance and prevent chaos within the vast Hongmeng Space, the Golden List enforces a strict law—only four of the largest universes may exist at any given time. Any new universes created beyond this limit will be significantly smaller in scale and remain subject to the oversight of the top four Hongmeng Controllers.

The Nascent Soul stage grants the cultivator access to Red True Fire, capable of easily killing ten early-stage Golden Core cultivators or contending with three to four late-stage ones. Lifespan extends by over 5,000 years, and sheer force renders human wave tactics ineffective.

An early-stage Nascent Soul cultivator cannot stop an army of two million but requires significant time to kill even 100,000 foes. Upon self-detonation, the explosion can be seen from over 100 li(50 kilometers) away; all internal-style martial artists within one kilometer perish instantly, while even innate experts beyond that range suffer serious injuries.

A peak late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator who survives the Six-Nine Major Heavenly Tribulation will ascend to the Cavernous Void stage.
